\documentclass{article}
\makeatletter
\newcounter{texmodelk}
% The .aux is read before this hook runs, so each pass sees the previous pass's number and writes one more.
\AtBeginDocument{%
  \@ifundefined{texmodelrun}{\gdef\texmodelrun{0}}{}%
  \setcounter{texmodelk}{\texmodelrun}\addtocounter{texmodelk}{1}}
\AtEndDocument{\immediate\write\@auxout{\string\gdef\string\texmodelrun{\thetexmodelk}}}
\makeatother
\begin{document}
Never settles.
\end{document}
